policy: A documented gap must remain null or absent in the dashboard. It may not be filled with an unlabeled interpolation, proxy, or extrapolation.

gaps.subject: United States technology scenarios after 2050
gaps.available: EIA AEO2026 and NREL Standard Scenarios 2024 end in 2050.
gaps.missing: A selected, validated U.S.-specific generation and capacity scenario from 2051 through approximately 2070.
gaps.dashboard_rule: End U.S. scenario lines in 2050. Do not downscale or relabel the World NGFS series as United States data.
next_source_candidates: DOE national studies with public 2070 outputs

gaps.subject: Wave, tidal-stream, ocean-current, OTEC, and salinity-gradient split
gaps.available: IRENASTAT provides a global Marine energy aggregate through 2025; IRENA WETO provides aggregate ocean-energy milestones to 2050.
gaps.missing: A consistent official global annual history and scenario series split by each marine conversion technology.
gaps.dashboard_rule: Label the available series Marine energy or Ocean energy. Do not label the aggregate Wave or infer technology shares.
next_source_candidates: Joint Research Centre ocean-energy status reports

gaps.subject: En-ROADS run output
gaps.available: The public architecture, equations, units, model boundaries, references, and clean-room implementation constraints are mapped.
gaps.missing: A licensed, reproducible export of selected En-ROADS scenario runs or a validated local clean-room implementation.
gaps.dashboard_rule: Use En-ROADS as an attributed architecture and interaction reference; do not present NGFS output as En-ROADS output.

gaps.subject: IEA World Energy Outlook 2025 scenario rows
gaps.available: The official free-dataset landing page documents global scenario values through 2050.
gaps.missing: Redistributable raw rows under terms confirmed for this public GitHub dashboard.
gaps.dashboard_rule: Link to the IEA product but do not ship its raw data until reuse terms are resolved.
next_source_candidates: IEA permission or compatible data license

gaps.subject: Global technology history before detailed source-specific coverage
gaps.available: OWID provides a processed global generation compilation with starts ranging from 1965 to 2000; IRENASTAT supplies detailed annual capacity from 2000 and generation through 2023.
gaps.missing: A single primary-source global series with uniform definitions across all technologies back to 1949.
gaps.dashboard_rule: Start each line at its first available observation and show the data source. Do not backfill zeros.

gaps.subject: Commercial fusion generation
gaps.available: Official research and commercialization roadmaps are cataloged in the broader energy corpus.
gaps.missing: Observed commercial generation or a source-supported national/global generation trajectory.
gaps.dashboard_rule: Show fusion only in a future-technology/readiness layer until actual generation or a clearly attributed scenario exists.
